articles.title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
articles.snippet: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

articles.title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market
articles.snippet: The ECB president called for common rules as the EU's new blockchain settlement system handled a 1 billion-euro ($1.1 billion) digital bond transaction.

articles.title: Wrapped Monero token plunges 99% as issuer-linked wallet sells $13.5 million
articles.snippet: The sell-off hit Wagyu’s XMR1 token, separate from Monero and Hyperliquid’s XMR futures market.

articles.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
articles.snippet: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

articles.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
articles.snippet: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.
